comment: * ModemPowerProfile for handling the modem element in the power_profile.xml

variables.name: mPowerConstants
variables.comment:
* A flattened list of the modem power constant extracted from the given XML parser.
     *
     * The bitfields of a key describes what its corresponding power constant represents:
     * [31:28] - {@link ModemDrainType} (max count = 16).
     * [27:24] - {@link ModemTxLevel} (only for {@link MODEM_DRAIN_TYPE_TX}) (max count = 16).
     * [23:20] - {@link ModemRatType} (max count = 16).
     * [19:16] - {@link ModemNrFrequencyRange} (only for {@link MODEM_RAT_TYPE_NR})
     * (max count = 16).
     * [15:0] - RESERVED

variables.name: MODEM_DRAIN_TYPE_SLEEP
variables.comment: * Corresponds to the overall modem battery drain while asleep.

variables.name: MODEM_DRAIN_TYPE_IDLE
variables.comment: * Corresponds to the overall modem battery drain while idle.

variables.name: MODEM_DRAIN_TYPE_RX
variables.comment:
* Corresponds to the modem battery drain while receiving data. A specific Rx battery drain
     * power constant can be selected using a bitwise OR (|) with {@link ModemRatType} and
     * {@link ModemNrFrequencyRange} (when applicable).

variables.name: MODEM_DRAIN_TYPE_TX
variables.comment:
* Corresponds to the modem battery drain while receiving data.
     * {@link ModemTxLevel} must be specified with this drain type.
     * Specific Tx battery drain power constanta can be selected using a bitwise OR (|) with
     * {@link ModemRatType} and {@link ModemNrFrequencyRange} (when applicable).

variables.name: MODEM_RAT_TYPE_DEFAULT
variables.comment:
* Fallback for any active modem usage that does not match specified Radio Access Technology
     * (RAT) power constants.

variables.name: MODEM_RAT_TYPE_LTE
variables.comment: * Corresponds to active modem usage on 4G {@link TelephonyManager#NETWORK_TYPE_LTE} RAT.

variables.name: MODEM_RAT_TYPE_NR
variables.comment: * Corresponds to active modem usage on 5G {@link TelephonyManager#NETWORK_TYPE_NR} RAT.

variables.name: MODEM_NR_FREQUENCY_RANGE_DEFAULT
variables.comment:
* Fallback for any active 5G modem usage that does not match specified NR frequency power
     * constants.

variables.name: MODEM_NR_FREQUENCY_RANGE_LOW
variables.comment: * Corresponds to active NR modem usage on {@link ServiceState#FREQUENCY_RANGE_LOW}.

variables.name: MODEM_NR_FREQUENCY_RANGE_MID
variables.comment: * Corresponds to active NR modem usage on {@link ServiceState#FREQUENCY_RANGE_MID}.

variables.name: MODEM_NR_FREQUENCY_RANGE_HIGH
variables.comment: * Corresponds to active NR modem usage on {@link ServiceState#FREQUENCY_RANGE_HIGH}.

variables.name: MODEM_NR_FREQUENCY_RANGE_MMWAVE
variables.comment: * Corresponds to active NR modem usage on {@link ServiceState#FREQUENCY_RANGE_MMWAVE}.
